column4: Prefer verifying on web or an already-booted device; shut down simulators when done (xcrun simctl shutdown all).
A simulator is already booted: reuse it instead of booting another.
Only one device at a time; stop it when done (adb emu kill).
iOS simulator is running: shut it down before starting Android.
Android emulator is running: stop it before starting iOS.
Run with --no-daemon or stop the daemon afterwards (./gradlew --stop).
Start only the services you need; stop them when done.
Free disk first (caches, old builds, docker system prune).
A dev server is already listening: reuse it instead of starting another, or pick a free port.
Watch mode never exits and will block the agent: run once (e.g. vitest run, CI=1), or start it in the background.
Interactive command will hang the agent: use a non-interactive form.
